reviews.title: Coinbase generates stability in the protection of financial assets.
reviews.pros:
The things I liked the most about Coinbase were:

1- It has an excellent asset exchange system, which allows you to exchange your local currency for any other currency that exists around the world, in addition, you can also exchange CryptoCurrencies within that platform, you can exchange your local currency in question of seconds, and best of all, this system charges very few commissions in this currency exchange.

2- It allows you to make payments to any email address in a matter of seconds, you can transfer any type of assets within the platform to any other user just by using their wallet number or their email, the transfer of assets is immediate, not additional time must be waited for the availability of this money.

3- You can store NFT assets within your Coinbase wallet, this is completely important since you can store any type of non-fungible Asset within this wallet without paying additional fees for storing them.

4- You can link your bank account to this platform and start buying all kinds of CryptoCurrencies by pressing a button, you do not have to use the same type of debit card or additional payment methods, you can start buying and selling any type of asset within Coinbase.
reviews.cons:
The things I don't like about this platform are:

1- Low profits, this platform offers a very high profitability in the asset staking system, this means that if you leave your files frozen within this wallet with the option of generating annual profitability, the annual profitability percentage is extremely low within this platform, as there are much better platforms out there today that offer much better annual rates of return.

2- The thanks of the assets are not managed in real time, which makes it difficult to visualize them at an updated price. The price of each asset takes a while to update every minute, you have to wait to be able to make a correct visualization of an asset's graph.
reviews.overall: Coinbase has generated great profitability for my assets, thanks to this wallet I have been able to store a large amount of assets in a totally secure way, in addition, I have been able to configure additional security to my wallet, adding a two-step PIN security to protect these assets. In general, I have felt very comfortable because it has ensured that assets remain safe at all times, in addition, I have been able to transfer a large amount of assets to any recipient in seconds, there is no type of transfer limit, which allows me to transfer or mobilize my money to any wallet without any restriction. Another positive thing about this platform is the amount of money that you can store within it, in addition, the user support within Coinbase is exceptional, they attend to any type of requirement and solve any problem that occurs with your assets in a matter of minutes. since they have a live chat. I will continue to use this platform as my primary measure to store my assets and NFTs.

reviews.title: Coinbase helps me keep my financial assets safe.
reviews.pros: Coinbase has been an exceptional service when it comes to storing large sums of money in a reliable way, that platform is using it for about three years, the main reason why they are used was because I wanted to keep my financial assets safe, this platform offered me the possibility of storing assets within the various wallets. One thing that I really liked about this platform is that it has the possibility to store NFT's within it, this platform offers me a section where I can store these non-expendable assets, which is fantastic since it helps that I don't have these assets. any type of loss and that they are stored safely. Another thing that I liked about this platform is the ability to easily exchange assets, I can exchange my local currency for any asset in the currency of another country or in Cryptocurrencies, it is very important since it allows me to exchange to any other currency or Crypto in a simple way and with very low commissions, it is important to highlight that this platform charges very few commissions when carrying out these currency conversations. Another positive aspect that can be found within this platform is regarding the general design, shape helps you to be able to position yourself correctly within it when handling it or when moving around within the different wallets. Again, your positive is that this platform takes very little time to correctly process money deposits, this platform allows you to deposit money from a debit or credit card, as well as using your bank account to make direct deposits, it only takes about five minutes to appear correctly in your Coinbase account, in addition, if you want to withdraw money within this platform, withdrawals are also processed quickly.
reviews.cons: A negative effect that can be considered within this platform is with respect to the support service, it currently has no type of real-time support service, you cannot communicate with Coinbase support with an online chat, the only way to contact by email, and I must emphasize that contacting them through this means is quite late, since it takes a long time to answer the requirements. Another negative function of Coinbase is regarding the staking system that exists within this platform, this system is quite negative since it offers very few profits for its users, in addition, you must leave the coins frozen in that staking for a long time to receive a total profit percentage, therefore, I do not recommend Coinbase to use it as Staking.
reviews.overall: In general, Coinbase has made me feel quite comfortable because it has helped me keep my financial assets completely safe, thanks to this platform I have been able to store a large amount of assets safely, also, the important thing about this platform is that I can transfer some amounts of money without any type of restriction, this platform is completely free and allows you to store and send unlimited money. In addition, the identity verification system when taking cards for the first time is quite easy to complete and you can do it in just a few minutes, to have your account completely verified and that you can store money within it. In conclusion, I consider that my experience within this platform has been completely positive, I have been able to enjoy low commissions when converting currencies to CryptoCurrencies or when transferring money to any wallet address. Coinbase has given me a very secure system when it comes to storing my assets, I have been able to activate two-step security as well as login security, to keep my assets even more secure. I will continue to use this platform in the long term, as I believe it has done a lot in keeping my financial assets safe, and in providing me with a very good quality and very fast service for processing transfers.

reviews.title: Great for newbies
reviews.pros: When I first downloaded Coinbase, I was a newbie in the crypto space. After just a few minutes of navigating the app, it was very easy to use and understand. In fact, I made my first crypto investment in minutes.
reviews.cons: In the beginning I was a little confused as to the difference between using Coinbase and Coinbase Pro app.
reviews.overall: Overall it’s been a positive experience. I have made quite a few purchases and everything has been smooth. I would recommend it for anyone looking to get into the crypto space.

reviews.title: Secure Crypto Management You Can Trust
reviews.pros: East to use interface and secure transactions. Easy to move assets around and in or out of your wallet.
reviews.cons: Higher fees come at a cost of security. But well worth the secure environment that Coinbase provides.
reviews.overall: I feel that Coinbase is secure and will not take off with anyone's crypto. Their fees are higher than others, but you can tell they put security at the front of their service.

reviews.title: Satisfactory, but not the best
reviews.pros: Good UI/UX and is quick. Easy to setup and use and has a wide variety of cryptocurrencies available for trading.
reviews.cons: Customer support is extremely lacking. Challenge to even get a response from them beyond the automated donotreply emails.
reviews.overall: A good trading platform but lacks customer support. May be better soon but i am sticking with another platform for now.

reviews.title: Great features, but understandably bad support.
reviews.pros: I like how easy they made the user interface. It's friendly, convenient and easy to use. The settings and instructions are clear.
reviews.cons: As I said in the title of this review, the customer support is not great. Very difficult to get an answer from a human being. I'm sure they're overwhelmed with all the influx of new customers, but they need to  scale better.
reviews.overall: Still one of the best ways to buy and sell crypto. Can't get much better, and it's only going up from here.

reviews.title: Coinbase has helped me make easy money
reviews.pros: This app is so simple to use. It has allowed me to make income I never dreamed possible. I highly recommend this software.
reviews.cons: I understand why this is the case but I hate that there isn't an instant cash option.
reviews.overall: Coinbase is an easy to use crypto market that allows users to monitor the markets on the fly. You have to use Coinbase Pro for limit trades.

reviews.title: Great for starting out
reviews.pros: I like that it offered a variety of sources to help its users get more familiar with crypto currencies in general and get their feet wet.
reviews.cons: Their fees are pretty high, which is surprising because their user interface is one of the easiest for new users.
reviews.overall: Overall I think it’s a great application and was helpful for me to get started  into the crypto space. Definitely would recommend to anyone looking to explore crypto currencies!

reviews.title: Coinbase
reviews.pros: Coinbase works well for buying and selling cryptocurrency. It has lots of different cryptocurrency options.
reviews.cons: I wish the fees were a little lower. Seems a little bit expensive.
reviews.overall: Coinbase is my primary resource that I use for investing in cryptocurrency. I would recommend it to others.

reviews.title: Best Crypto Exchange
reviews.pros: Very easy to use, fees aren't that bad to most also if you trade on pro. Able to send and receive money quick. Also able to send and receive crypto as well.
reviews.cons: Doesn't have all the coins on the exchange but it's adding more and more each day.
reviews.overall: Overall my experience with coin base has been great! I have been a member since 2016 and will not go elsewhere.
